segments.text: Welcome everybody.
In today's class we are going to break down three things. The basic step, the Suzie Q, and a short combination.
Take your time with each one.
This step is called the basic step.
We dance it on two.
Start with your left foot.
Break on two, transfer the weight completely, and come back on six.
The most important detail is the weight transfer.
Do not rush it, and keep the supporting knee soft.
Let us do it slowly with the counts.
Five, six, seven, eight.
One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight.
One more time.
One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight.
Now with the music. Here we go.
This one is called the Suzie Q.
Cross in front, open, and cross again.
Keep the knees soft and rotate from the torso, not from the arms.
A common mistake is lifting the heel too early.
Keep the heel down until the weight arrives.
Slowly now.
Cross, open, cross, open.
Keep the pressure into the floor.
Now let us put it together into a small combination.
We start with the basic step, then two Suzie Qs, and we finish with a right turn.
The turn preparation happens on six, so do not be late.
First the whole thing slowly.
Full combination with the music. Here we go.
and eh, this one, some people call it differently, we can maybe look at it another day

Practice the weight transfer at seventy five percent speed.
See you next week.
